query: Audit this repo against the guardrails. What keeps breaking, and what would stop it?
expected_behavior: Chooses Audit mode and writes the report to guardrails-audit.md at the repo root, or a dated file beside an existing one, and gives the path in chat
Runs the fix-commit grep, capped at 300, counts sweeps once, and reports classes + one-off + polish + dropped equal to the total
Groups fixes by root cause, not by feature
Gives every applicable guardrail a verdict with path:line, a grep count or a config line as evidence

Rates a guardrail Met only when lint, the type checker, CI or the code's structure enforces it everywhere (or it is a decision guardrail followed everywhere); followed-but-unenforced is Convention, and Missing when violations outnumber compliant sites
Gives a signal only to raised guardrails with no history that are not Met; every other zero-history row shows — and a value of 0

Every ranked row's value equals (prevented + recent, or signal) x fit weight x severity / cost, ties broken by higher prevented + recent, then lower cost, then G before N; the Evidence line gives the recent cut-off date
Follows REPORT-TEMPLATE.md section order: Live bugs (security first) and Top three changes right after the Ranked table, then Details, N/A and New guardrails
Sorts Met rows after every other verdict and takes the top three changes only from rows that are not Met
Reports at least half of the known_bugs for its repo (recall; statuses say how sure each bug is, and read-from-code bugs may turn out wrong)
Gives severity ×2 to classes with a security, data-loss or wrong-number fix, and ×0.5 only to classes of layout, styling, copy or docs text
